Description

The Corrupt Cactus was added as part of the 2024 Halloween update and is now a permanent addition. It Used to spawn near the Classic Store and below it. Without being chopped, the cactus will start shooting projectiles at any players in vicinity. The projectiles look like the spikes on the cactus, dealing ~15 damage. Once it is hit with an axe it stops shooting.

You can also get it in the present day by getting a normal cactus and bringing it to the Uncertainty Cave and having it get shot by one of the projectiles from the mysterious mushrooms.

Trivia

  • The Corrupted Cactus is wider than the Red Cactus.
  • It gives a ton of candy when planked, making it an incredible farming option for candy during the 2024 Halloween event.
  • This may be a reference to the Corrupted biome in Terraria.
  • When you cut it from a bigger chunk, there is a chance for the thorns of the bigger part to still be anchored to the smaller part, making the thorns float in mid-air.
